entities.description: reusable entity set extracted from a scene: each entry is an entity document WITHOUT its id (regenerated on instantiate) — { name, Transform, ...components }

root_entity.description: name of the prefab root entity (instantiation origin when offset is applied)

source_scene.description: scene the prefab was extracted from (informational)

source_entity_ids.description: entity UUIDs the prefab was extracted from (informational)
